title: The Year-End Review: Rethinking a Learning Plan · 独立口语迁移
instructions: 先完成示范段的跟读诊断，再用不同人物、信息或立场录制自己的完整回答。示范与自由回答分别取证，服务未提供完整听音评阅时保持待评。
reference: For twelve months, Mei had followed a strict study plan. Every morning she reviewed fifty new words, listened to a podcast for thirty minutes, and wrote a short paragraph. She rarely missed a day. Yet when she took a practice test in November, her score had barely moved. 'I feel like I've been running on a treadmill,' she told her teacher, Mr. Chen. 'I'm working hard, but I'm not going anywhere.' This is a common experience among language learners: effort alone does not guarantee progress if the effort is not directed well. Mei had confused activity with achievement, and the result was frustration rather than improvement. Many learners believe that more hours and more words must lead to better results, but without feedback and review, hard work can simply repeat the same weaknesses. In Mei's case, the daily routine felt productive because it was busy, but it never forced her to notice what she was getting wrong. Mr.
